upheld.title: Non-link 'No products yet' card shows hover feedback like a link
upheld.detail: The hover border and shadow are on .surface-card, which every brand card carries, so the empty card that is not a link (Acme Empty) lifts on hover like the clickable cards, and linked and unlinked cards look identical at rest. Users get a clickable affordance on a card that does nothing.
